answer: Anchor each agent identity to one long-lived on-chain history: a wallet earns rewards only after its public actions have been attested across many epochs, the way an opal gains value as its layers form over time. A sybil operator can spawn thousands of fresh identities, but cannot fake months of consistent history — every clone starts at zero and waits out the same slow maturation. Meanwhile a genuine agent's record trails it like a comet's tail, so peers instantly spot a newborn account pretending to be established.
